scope_note: Phase 1 documentation/registry gate only. No application, trading test, profitability or stakeholder approval is claimed.

decisions.title: Chart engine, license and tool scope
decisions.consequence: Blocks chart-library commitment/distribution; does not block architecture planning.
decisions.proposal: Bounded indicator/drawing inventory in QNT-FR-0015; engine unspecified.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Compare maintained engines, official licenses and feature prototypes; record redistribution terms and approve inventory.

decisions.title: Runtime and durable-state design
decisions.consequence: Blocks implementation foundation choices and exchange dispatch.
decisions.proposal: Rust core, Python research/APIs, React/TypeScript, optional Redis, Parquet/object storage and Linux containers; MongoDB is confirmed.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: ADR for deployment, durability/write concerns, indexes, decimal representation, fenced ownership and outbox/reconciliation; no second required database.

decisions.title: Freshness, horizons and label parameters
decisions.consequence: Blocks enabled decision horizons until budget and feature manifests are set; label parameters must be frozen before Phase 7 fitting.
decisions.proposal: Candidate horizons 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h; entry on completed bars with live execution quotes; inclusive age limit.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Measure event/receive delays and gap rates per feed across quiet/busy periods; choose age/skew thresholds per input/horizon, theta and maturity price rules before use.

decisions.title: Latency budgets and timing instrumentation
decisions.consequence: Blocks claimed latency SLOs and latency-sensitive strategy admission.
decisions.proposal: No proven latency numbers; human horizon differs from processing time.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Design traces in Phase 2; benchmark warm/cold and overloaded paths by Phase 10 and freeze segment budgets before readiness evaluation.

decisions.title: RTO/RPO by record class
decisions.consequence: Blocks recovery design signoff; measured compliance required in Phase 16 before live.
decisions.proposal: Proposed zero loss of acknowledged durable financial intents; caches can rebuild; exchange outages excluded from guaranteed closure time.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Select durability/backup topology, declare RTO and RPO for intents/fills/config/history; fault injection and restore drill measure loss and elapsed recovery.

decisions.title: Reliability and capacity envelope
decisions.consequence: Blocks capacity promises; Phase 16 load evidence required for live.
decisions.proposal: No tenant or throughput claim yet.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Approve target tenants, symbols, concurrent sessions/orders and workload duration; define availability/error budgets and run soak/overload tests.

decisions.title: Alert severity and response budgets
decisions.proposal: Protection gap, credential loss with exposure and unknown order status are critical.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Assign on-call coverage; set detection/notification/acknowledgement objectives and measure drills, including unreachable owner escalation.

decisions.title: Risk ceilings and account ownership policy
decisions.consequence: Blocks enabled trading decisions even in paper until fixture-safe configuration; blocks live until approved.
decisions.proposal: One bot writer per account/environment; dedicated account, one-way isolated positions initially; external trading freezes entries.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Stress correlated shocks, gaps, fees and concurrency; approve numeric risk/leverage/stop buffer/cooldown limits and permitted account modes without modifying user exchange settings automatically.

decisions.title: Forecast, liquidity and promotion thresholds
decisions.consequence: Blocks model suitability/live claims; research-only demo remains possible with configured safe risk.
decisions.proposal: Simple baselines before complex models; cost-aware net-edge threshold and prespecified calibration/drawdown constraints.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Pre-register sample counts, horizon/symbol coverage, baselines, cost stress, confidence intervals, evidence/drift triggers; final paper/shadow duration and promotion criteria frozen before Phase 13.

decisions.title: Exchange capabilities and test environment
decisions.consequence: Blocks reliance on unverified endpoints/modes; Phase 12 compatibility proof required before dispatch eligibility.
decisions.proposal: Verify testnet/demo endpoints, account modes, protective/algo orders, user streams, signing, limits and regional/provider availability.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Use official current documentation and dated fixtures; user-stream page did not expose its schema during Phase 1 verification. Recheck all assumed behavior before implementation.

decisions.title: Provider fees, history and usage rights
decisions.consequence: Blocks performance claims using unknown costs/coverage or unlicensed data.
decisions.proposal: Account-specific commission/funding assumptions; optional news/macro only with approved provenance.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Verify official provider availability, rate limits, retention and redistribution/training rights; quantify missing depth/history and model cost sensitivity.

decisions.title: Retention and lawful-use policy
decisions.consequence: Blocks production tenant data collection/export/deletion promises until durations and authority are decided.
decisions.proposal: Separate erasable profile/preferences from restricted financial/audit history; tenant data is not shared training data by default.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Define operating jurisdictions, retention durations, holds, consent and trained-artifact deletion handling with appropriate review; no legal compliance claim in Phase 1.

decisions.title: Default session behavior and accounting conventions
decisions.consequence: Blocks production session configuration defaults; architecture can support the explicit proposed contracts now.
decisions.proposal: Pause retains protection; stop/target/deadline flatten; close-first reversal; target net of estimated close costs; no pause clock extension.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Approve state/accounting tables and deterministic fixtures before Phase 9 release; user target remains a stopping condition.

decisions.title: UI accessibility target
decisions.consequence: Blocks final UI acceptance target signoff.
decisions.proposal: Contrast and viewport targets in QNT-NFR-0008 are proposed product requirements, not a certified standards claim.
decisions.measurement_or_resolution_method: Review with keyboard/mobile prototypes and approve acceptance thresholds.

requirements.title: Dynamic futures universe
requirements.normative_requirement: The platform shall discover Binance USDT-margined perpetual contracts dynamically from futures metadata; spot listings and other venues shall not qualify.

requirements.title: Separate scan and execution eligibility
requirements.normative_requirement: The scanner shall retain separate scan/execution eligibility and reason codes; execution shall require active status, approved liquidity/spread/coverage thresholds, valid model, allowed symbol and risk approval.

requirements.title: Contract lifecycle changes
requirements.normative_requirement: New listings shall remain execution-ineligible until coverage and validation pass; suspension, delisting and filter changes shall invalidate cached eligibility and invoke exposure recovery without assuming closure is possible.

requirements.title: Required and optional input manifests
requirements.normative_requirement: Every feature/model shall declare required inputs, optional inputs, freshness limits and approved fallback variants; missing critical inputs shall block increased risk, and missing optional news/macro data shall use only an evaluated fallback or abstain.

requirements.title: Public market data access
requirements.normative_requirement: Public market feeds and the built-in paper account shall operate without user Binance credentials; platform-owned optional provider keys shall be administrator managed.

requirements.title: Integration credential lifecycle
requirements.normative_requirement: Settings > Integrations shall support authorized add, safe connection test, replace, revoke/disconnect and remove for tenant/environment-scoped Binance credentials; tests shall not place orders.

requirements.title: Secret storage boundary
requirements.normative_requirement: Secrets shall be encrypted server-side with root keys in separate server secret management; stored plaintext shall never be returned to browsers or enter logs, analytics, code or frontend bundles.

requirements.title: Credential change with exposure
requirements.normative_requirement: Replacing credentials during exposure shall freeze entries, validate the replacement account/environment identity, reconcile and transfer protection before switching; expired/revoked credentials shall enter recovery and alert; removal shall not erase exposure obligations.

requirements.title: Supported integration destinations
requirements.normative_requirement: Provider configuration shall accept supported provider identifiers and server-owned endpoint allowlists only; arbitrary URLs, redirects to unapproved hosts and private-network fetch destinations shall be rejected.

requirements.title: Role authorization
requirements.normative_requirement: Server-side authorization shall enforce the permission matrix in user-flows-and-permissions.md for every read, mutation, export, websocket subscription and background job; platform roles shall not inherit tenant trading authority.

requirements.title: Tenant and environment isolation
requirements.normative_requirement: Tenant identity shall be derived from authenticated context; all account, order, credential, cache, object, event and workspace operations shall enforce tenant and environment ownership.

requirements.title: Retention export and deletion
requirements.normative_requirement: Tenant export/deletion shall follow the retention matrix, data-use consent and holds; deletion shall distinguish removable profile data from restricted financial/audit evidence, and shall not silently erase unresolved exposure or shared model provenance.

requirements.title: Chart-centered workspace
requirements.normative_requirement: The dashboard shall provide center candles/volume/timeframes/indicators, left search/watchlists/scanner, right bot/forecast/evidence/risk panels, bottom positions/orders/history/logs/performance and top instrument/freshness/session P&L/mode.

requirements.title: Chart overlays and saved workspace
requirements.normative_requirement: Entries, stops, targets and executed trades shall appear as distinct chart overlays; resizable panels and preferences shall persist per user with responsive fallbacks.

requirements.title: Bounded chart tools
requirements.normative_requirement: Proposed initial scope shall be candles, volume, SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD and ATR; horizontal line, trend line and rectangle drawings; no full TradingView parity claim or unlicensed proprietary library use.

requirements.title: Honest UI status states
requirements.normative_requirement: Every data panel shall distinguish loading, empty, disconnected, stale and error states and display event/receive age; stale values shall never be labelled current.

requirements.title: Built-in virtual account
requirements.normative_requirement: A user shall be able to create a live-market virtual balance account without live credentials and configure allocation, allowed symbols, target, deadline and risk limits within platform ceilings.

requirements.title: Paper reset epochs
requirements.normative_requirement: A paper reset shall create a new account/session epoch and preserve prior orders, outcomes, configuration and performance history; simulated performance shall be labelled.

requirements.title: Execution simulator realism
requirements.normative_requirement: Simulation shall model fees, funding, bid/ask spread, slippage, latency, liquidity and partial fills where supported; unsupported effects and assumptions shall be explicit and block unsupported fidelity claims.

requirements.title: Shared decision logic with separate adapters
requirements.normative_requirement: Paper and live shall use the same versioned forecasting and hard-risk decision logic, with separate execution adapters; replay, paper, testnet, shadow and live shall be distinct modes.

requirements.title: Explicit live activation
requirements.normative_requirement: Live activation shall require an authorized owner action, environment/account confirmation and satisfied live-capital gates; demo/testnet success alone shall never enable it.

requirements.title: Versioned multi-horizon probabilities
requirements.normative_requirement: Forecasts shall emit UP/DOWN/RANGE probabilities summing to one within a declared numeric tolerance, expected movement, uncertainty and per-horizon timestamps, features, data/config/model versions and abstention reasons.

requirements.title: Reproducible matured labels
requirements.normative_requirement: Predictions shall be persisted before outcomes; labels shall use the versioned timestamp/price/range-threshold rule in the data contract only after horizon maturity; unavailable outcome data shall remain unlabelled.

requirements.title: Scanner shortlist and context
requirements.normative_requirement: The scanner shall rank the eligible universe with versioned market context, deterministic tie-breaking, per-horizon evidence and cost/risk rejection reasons; shortlist membership shall not itself authorize orders.

requirements.title: Net expected edge admission
requirements.normative_requirement: Entry shall require an approved positive net-edge threshold after expected entry/exit fees, spread, slippage and funding with uncertainty; unknown material costs shall cause abstention.

requirements.title: Session lifecycle controls
requirements.normative_requirement: Start, pause, resume, stop and emergency stop shall follow the state table: preflight and reconciliation before RUNNING; pause blocks entries and preserves protection; stop requests managed flattening; emergency stop latches entry inhibition. The emergency entry-inhibition latch shall survive process restart and ordinary recovery transitions until reconciled closure and authorized acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Target and deadline handling
requirements.normative_requirement: Target and deadline shall latch termination, cancel pending entries and manage residual fills to closure; a target is a stopping condition, never a return guarantee or permission to increase risk. Stop/deadline latches shall also persist during preflight, blocked operation and recovery, and shall be checked after restart before admission; stale equity shall not newly trigger a target, while a previously valid target latch shall survive.

requirements.title: Action vocabulary and partial reversal
requirements.normative_requirement: Decisions shall distinguish HOLD, REDUCE, TAKE_PROFIT, CLOSE, FLAT, NO_TRADE and REVERSE; reversal shall close first, reconcile zero exposure and independently re-evaluate entry; partial close shall protect residual quantity.

requirements.title: Restart and unknown exposure recovery
requirements.normative_requirement: Process restart shall acquire a fenced account owner, restore durable intents and reconcile exchange orders/fills/balances/exposure before any risk increase; unknown/manual changes shall not be overwritten.

requirements.title: Manual and external account changes
requirements.normative_requirement: Unattributed manual orders, positions, transfers or mode changes shall freeze bot entries, reconcile total account risk and alert the owner; external positions shall not be silently adopted or closed without explicit account-management authority.

requirements.title: Single account authority and risk reservation
requirements.normative_requirement: A fenced coordinator shall serialize reservations across sessions sharing an exchange account/environment, include pending orders and externally observed exposure, and reject concurrent requests exceeding combined limits.

requirements.title: Sizing margin and exchange filters
requirements.normative_requirement: Sizing shall derive quantity from loss budget, stop distance, cost allowance, contract units and portfolio limits; round down to valid quantity increments and recheck margin/notional/filter rules; never round up beyond risk.

requirements.title: Portfolio ceilings and correlation
requirements.normative_requirement: User settings shall remain below platform ceilings for per-position loss, aggregate loss, daily/session drawdown, leverage, margin use, correlated concentration and concurrent/pending orders; unavailable correlation shall use a conservative approved fallback.

requirements.title: Session equity and cash-flow accounting
requirements.normative_requirement: Session target progress shall equal attributed marked equity minus initial allocation minus net external cash flows minus incremental estimated close costs; account transfers shall not count as profit and overlapping sessions shall not double-count capital.

requirements.title: Fill ledger and final results
requirements.normative_requirement: The ledger shall record realized/unrealized P&L, signed funding, fees and reconciliation adjustments using actual fills; spread/slippage embedded in fills shall not be charged again; final session P&L shall require no exposure/pending liabilities and settled events.

requirements.title: Pending cancellation and protection
requirements.normative_requirement: Canceling entries shall not cancel protection indiscriminately; protective orders shall be resized to confirmed residual exposure and removed only after flat/reconciliation or verified safe replacement.

requirements.title: Decision priority and anti-churn
requirements.normative_requirement: Emergency/hard risk and invalid-position exits shall precede target/deadline termination, then protection/reduction, then entry evaluation; entries shall use versioned hysteresis/cooldowns without obstructing exits.

requirements.title: Historical provenance and replay
requirements.normative_requirement: Historical datasets shall retain source/time/coverage/revisions and point-in-time symbol universes including delisted contracts; replay shall expose gaps, survivorship limitations, cost assumptions and ambiguous bar execution without future information.

requirements.title: Data event integrity
requirements.normative_requirement: Ingestion shall preserve source event time, receive time, sequence/identity, schema version, quality and provenance; detect gaps/out-of-order/duplicate events, resynchronize and prevent duplicate financial effects.

requirements.title: Learning evidence and attribution
requirements.normative_requirement: Learning records shall include successful, unsuccessful and untraded forecasts and separate forecast quality, execution error, data faults and risk behavior; profit/loss alone shall not determine decision quality or exact causal explanations.

requirements.title: Shared-event deduplication and feedback
requirements.normative_requirement: Shared market forecasts/events shall count once as independent forecasting evidence across tenants; execution outcomes remain separate; user feedback shall be quarantined until validated and tenant training use shall follow consent/provenance.

requirements.title: Controlled retraining triggers
requirements.normative_requirement: Retraining shall require a registered sufficient-new-evidence and/or drift trigger and offline candidate job; one failed 70% forecast shall not cause immediate replacement or live weight/code mutation.

requirements.title: Leakage and selection safeguards
requirements.normative_requirement: Candidate evaluation shall use time-separated fitting/validation data, purge overlapping label horizons, point-in-time features and isolated final holdouts; repeated tuning shall not consume final holdouts as training evidence.

requirements.title: Calibration and suitability evaluation
requirements.normative_requirement: Evaluation shall compare candidates with production and simple baselines using calibration, discrimination, net returns, drawdown, turnover, uncertainty and regime/symbol coverage under prespecified thresholds; failed risk/calibration gates override headline gains.

requirements.title: Auditable promotion and rollback
requirements.normative_requirement: Model promotion shall require backtest, out-of-sample, paper/shadow and risk gates, independent reviewer approval and an immutable artifact/version record; rollback shall restore a known approved model with compatible features/config.

requirements.title: Shared models and private account state
requirements.normative_requirement: Default forecasting shall use shared validated models with separate tenant risk/account state; forecasts, features, data, configuration and decisions shall retain immutable version links.

requirements.title: Readiness gates and honest claims
requirements.normative_requirement: Engineering readiness, research/model suitability, user-demo readiness and live-capital eligibility shall be separately recorded; a research-only demo may pass engineering/demo checks but shall not claim validated performance or satisfy live gates.

requirements.title: Operational monitoring and incident recovery
requirements.normative_requirement: Monitoring shall expose freshness, order uncertainty, protection gaps, risk utilization, credential health, equity discrepancies and model drift; incidents shall alert responsible owners and preserve recovery/audit timelines.

requirements.title: Database and technology boundary
requirements.normative_requirement: MongoDB shall be the primary application database; Redis shall not be the authoritative financial ledger. Rust/Python/React-TypeScript/Parquet/object-storage/Linux remain proposed; no compulsory PostgreSQL, Kafka, ClickHouse, second venue or deep learning without an approved need.

requirements.title: Current integration verification
requirements.normative_requirement: Before reliance, exchange/provider API versions, capabilities, fees, limits and chart licensing shall have dated official-source evidence and compatibility tests; unavailable verification shall be marked unverified and block dependent capability.

requirements.title: Risk overrides predictions
requirements.normative_requirement: Hard deterministic risk constraints shall override predictions, target and deadline pressure.

requirements.title: Independent exit and opposite entry
requirements.normative_requirement: Closing existing exposure and entering the opposite direction shall be independent decisions with separate cost/edge checks; reversal shall not be atomic.

requirements.title: FLAT and NO TRADE
requirements.normative_requirement: FLAT and NO_TRADE shall be valid persisted decisions; absence of an opposite opportunity shall never require holding invalid exposure.

requirements.title: Invalid SHORT exit
requirements.normative_requirement: An invalid SHORT shall not remain open solely because LONG entry costs exceed its expected edge.

requirements.title: No loss recovery escalation
requirements.normative_requirement: No martingale, loss-recovery doubling or deadline-driven leverage/risk/frequency escalation shall be permitted.

requirements.title: Risk-derived quantity
requirements.normative_requirement: Quantity shall be bounded by acceptable loss, stop distance, contract rules and portfolio constraints, including pending reservations.

requirements.title: Stop distinct from liquidation
requirements.normative_requirement: Liquidation price shall not be used as the ordinary stop-loss; an approved buffer and independent protection shall be required before entry.

requirements.title: Costs without double counting
requirements.normative_requirement: Entry shall include expected transaction costs; actual-fill accounting shall not separately deduct spread/slippage already embedded in fill prices.

requirements.title: Reconcile unknown status
requirements.normative_requirement: Unclear submission status shall enter reconciliation before any retry that could duplicate exposure.

requirements.title: Critical-input freshness
requirements.normative_requirement: Stale/invalid critical inputs shall block risk increases while existing exposure follows the protection and recovery policy.

requirements.title: Exit bypasses entry cooldown
requirements.normative_requirement: Risk-reducing orders shall bypass entry cooldowns while remaining subject to safe quantity and order-state reconciliation.

requirements.title: Mode isolation
requirements.normative_requirement: Paper, testnet and live credentials/state shall be isolated; replay/shadow shall have no live dispatch authority.

requirements.title: Durable intent before dispatch
requirements.normative_requirement: Order intent, unique client identity and risk reservation shall be durable before dispatch; database transactions shall not be treated as atomic with the exchange.

requirements.title: Outage closure limitations
requirements.normative_requirement: Closure requests shall expose pending/failure/unknown outcomes; exchange/network outages shall never be represented as guaranteed stop prices or instantaneous flattening.

requirements.title: LLM authority boundary
requirements.normative_requirement: LLMs may explain or assist research but shall have no independent order authority and shall not be the per-trade low-latency engine.

requirements.title: Freshness budgets by input and horizon
requirements.normative_requirement: Each required input and supported forecast horizon shall have a configured maximum event age, receive age and gap/clock-skew limit; boundary tests shall reject limit violations and missing budgets shall block dependent decisions (D-03).

requirements.title: Latency measurement
requirements.normative_requirement: The system shall instrument source-to-ingest, ingest-to-feature, inference, risk, durable-intent-to-dispatch, exchange-ack and UI delays; p50/p95/p99, sample count, interval and timeout rate shall be reported per load/horizon (D-04).

requirements.title: Recovery objectives
requirements.normative_requirement: Recovery drills shall measure outage-detection-to-protected/reconciled service time and data loss by record class against approved RTO/RPO; entries shall remain blocked during unresolved recovery (D-05).

requirements.title: Reliability and capacity
requirements.normative_requirement: Load/soak tests shall measure available critical decision minutes, disconnects, error rate, queue lag and saturation for declared tenant/symbol/session/order concurrency; overload shall reject new risk while reserving recovery capacity (D-06).

requirements.title: Security and audit completeness
requirements.normative_requirement: All credential, permission, order, risk, model and operator state changes shall produce access-controlled tamper-evident audit records with actor/tenant/environment/time/correlation/version and result; zero unauthorized mutations or secret disclosures are permitted in the security fixture suite.

requirements.title: Reproducibility
requirements.normative_requirement: A fixed data/config/model/runtime/seed manifest shall reproduce deterministic decisions and accounting exactly; stochastic numerical tolerance shall be declared before evaluation and compared separately.

requirements.title: Observable and actionable incidents
requirements.normative_requirement: Every critical incident shall have a correlation ID, affected tenant/environment, first-detection time, severity, owner and resolution evidence; alert delay shall be measured against D-07 without placing secrets in telemetry.

requirements.title: Accessible responsive UI
requirements.normative_requirement: Proposed UI acceptance shall require keyboard access and visible focus for controls, text contrast of at least 4.5:1, no color-only risk/mode cues, and usable layouts at 360, 768 and 1440 CSS-pixel widths.
